name: Zukk'ash Report
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
You've done doubly well in addressing the threat that the Zukk'ash insects pose to Camp Mojache.  The threat these things pose is far from over, and I'd like to ask you for one last task on behalf of the Horde.

This is a document that details all the information we have learned about these Zukk'ash insects.  I want you to deliver it to Zilzibin Drumlore in the Drag of Orgrimmar.  He's an expert on alien creatures like these; I hope he can do something with the lore we've obtained.
narrative.objectives: Deliver the Camp Mojache Zukk'ash Report to Zilzibin Drumlore.  He resides in the Drag of Orgrimmar.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, I've been expecting this.  These creatures you faced... they are an ancient threat that the Horde continues to choose to ignore.  Hadoken was wise to bring this - and you - to me.

The Zukk'ash are nothing more than creatures called the silithid.  Some would think that they are a mindless nuisance, but let me assure you - they are a far, far worse threat than anything the Alliance could muster.

If you're willing and strong enough, I could use your aid in bringing this threat to light.
narrative.requestItemsText: Greetings friend... you look as though you are on urgent business.  Is there something I can help you with?

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 42 to 48, 23,150 XP in all.

quests.name: War on the Woodpaw
quests.objectiveText: Bring 10 Woodpaw Gnoll Manes to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Alpha Strike
quests.objectiveText: Kill 5 Woodpaw Alphas and return to Hadoken Swiftstrider within one hour.

quests.name: Woodpaw Investigation
quests.objectiveText: Find the gnoll battle plans somewhere in the gnoll camps to the south of Camp Mojache.

quests.name: The Battle Plans
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Woodpaw Battle Plans to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Zukk'ash Infestation
quests.objectiveText: Bring 20 Zukk'ash Carapaces to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

quests.name: Stinglasher
quests.objectiveText: Defeat Stinglasher in the Writhing Deep, bringing its glands back to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

quests.name: Zukk'ash Report
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Camp Mojache Zukk'ash Report to Zilzibin Drumlore.
